name: Say Yes to Everything
source:
You run a VR dating-rehearsal service.  People book you to practice first dates so they're less nervous for the real thing. Your newest client is different. Alistair Hawthorne is an old man with a terminal diagnosis, days away from an assisted-dying appointment in Switzerland. He’s not sad. He wants three days of anime-inspired dates before he goes.

[From [url=https://lilalove.itch.io/say-yes-to-everything]itch.io[/url]]
